public_rationale: The record contains practical deployment, expanded scientific prediction capabilities and serious software-engineering limitations. These findings challenge an absolute claim that nothing new happened, but Zitron said very little. The sources do not establish a representative measure of substantive novelty across the intended field. Treating selected advances as decisive would add a threshold and scope he did not supply; treating a difficult benchmark as proof of stagnation would overstate that evidence.
limitations: Company-reported usage does not independently establish effectiveness or novelty.
AlphaFold 3 may fall outside the intended LLM-centered scope.
The benchmark result describes the evaluated models and setup, not all systems available at the post date.
The distinction between substantive novelty and useful iteration remains judgment-dependent.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that generative AI had added few substantive capabilities or practical uses during the preceding eighteen months, beyond refinements of existing answer generation.
Very little permits some advances. A single new application cannot automatically contradict it.
Use January 8, 2023 through July 8, 2024 by subtracting eighteen months from publication. This operationalizes an approximate interval rather than dating a bubble objectively.
Count demonstrated or deployed capabilities, while distinguishing them from announced ambitions and distinguishing improved performance from newly enabled tasks.
Consider both the broad generative-AI wording and the surrounding emphasis on LLMs; do not silently assume that every scientific generative model falls within the intended scope.
criteria.support_condition: A representative comparison with the beginning of the interval would show little substantive expansion of reproducible capabilities or practical uses, with developments predominantly improving existing tasks.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A representative comparison would show substantial expansion into reproducible capabilities or practical uses beyond the baseline, sufficient to challenge the ordinary meaning of very little.

evidence.explanation: The company documents use of an application providing visual assistance, making it relevant countercontext to a broad dismissal of practical developments. Usage alone does not establish how novel the tasks were or whether this exceeds very little.

The paper describes a diffusion-based model covering joint structures involving proteins, nucleic acids and other molecules, with improvements over specialized tools. This challenges a broad dismissal of generative-model developments, but its relevance depends on whether scientific models fall within the intended LLM-centered scope.

The reported SWE-bench evaluation documents substantial difficulty with real repository issues. It supports a narrower concern about model limitations, but does not measure industry-wide novelty or establish performance for every system available by July 2024.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A representative comparison of capabilities and deployed uses at the beginning and end of the interval, with reproducible evidence of newly enabled tasks. A decisive judgment also requires a defensible interpretation of very little and the intended model scope.
